build.command: npm pack ./packages/client --json --pack-destination <output>; the existing prepack script runs the client build
build.dependencySource: npm ci --ignore-scripts --force in a clean full git archive of sourceRevision on darwin-arm64; --force bypasses the root linux-only os/cpu declaration. npm run build:client, npm run check:openapi and npm run test:client passed on Node 24.22.3. npm run verify:client was not run because Node 22.23.3 was unavailable.
